caption: The drawing features a large, elaborate floral and scroll design executed primarily in blue on a beige background. The central motif is a stylized, circular flower with a dotted center, encircled by a ring of small blue rounded shapes. Extending outward from the flower, there are several curved and spiral lines, as well as accent dots and shorter curved lines, creating an ornate and symmetrical composition. To the right side of the drawing, there is a smaller outline of a two-handled crock or pot, drawn in blue, with the same floral and scroll design displayed on its side. Above the main decorative motif, the words “ALBANY. NY” and the number "2" are written in capital letters and blue ink. The name "John Tarantino" appears at the lower left of the ornament. The overall color palette consists of blue tones on a neutral background, with some shading to accentuate the drawing.
title: Crock
